scope: Whole surviving heritage complex: adjoining Yards 1, 3 and 4 with high weathered stone enclosure/party walls, pedestrian gateways, reconstructed gabion boundary work, low archaeological foundation remnants, the Matron’s Cottage with twin hipped roofs, west/east verandas, north bay and chimneys, and the mapped modern History and Interpretation Centre. Lost roofed prison ranges, Yards 2/5 now developed, adjacent houses/industrial buildings, sculptures and independent art are excluded.
